items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And that band was Dias, Horace Dias on piano. Nappy LeMond on the guitar. Elroy Mays on clarinet. Charlie Hartman on trombone. Johnny and myself.

ctx.x: There's some singing on some of those. Huh? There's some singing on some of those Johnny Hyman songs. Oh, I don't know.

I don't know. I don't know. Maybe some of the ones that we made up at WSMB. But this was for Victor. Yeah. Uh, Alligator Crawl. And that band was Dias, Horace Dias on piano. Nappy LeMond on the guitar. Elroy Mays on clarinet. Charlie Hartman on trombone. Johnny and myself. And, and, and, huh? A bass? No bass. No.
